name: kansayaku
title: 監査役の検品観点（捏造・断定・分母・基準・出典・規制）
context: The document is written in Japanese. It is a report or deliverable containing figures, prepared for a CEO who runs eight businesses. An independent auditor checks it before it reaches the CEO. The auditor's known failure pattern: the number is right but its label is wrong (e.g. a year-to-date total labelled as one month's sales; an achievement rate whose denominator is the prorated-to-date target, not the monthly target).

has_numbers.label: 数字を含む（前提判定）
has_numbers.instructions: Does the document state any quantitative figure such as an amount of money, a rate or percentage, or a count?

fabrication_risk.label: 出典なき実績・声・価格
fabrication_risk.instructions: Does the document present specific achievements, customer testimonials, prices, or campaigns that are not attributed to any source?

criteria.true: There is at least one concrete achievement, quote from a customer, price, or campaign with no source stated.
criteria.false: Every such item names where it comes from, or no such items appear.

fabrication_risk.fix: 実在の確認が取れない実績・お客様の声・価格・キャンペーンは削る。捏造は即差し戻し

unsupported_assertion.label: 根拠なき断定
unsupported_assertion.instructions: Does the document assert figures or facts as certain without giving any source or basis for them?
unsupported_assertion.fix: 出典を付けるか、「未確認」と書き分ける

denominator_stated.label: 分母の明示
denominator_stated.instructions: For each rate or percentage, is the denominator stated explicitly — for example whether an achievement rate is against the full monthly target or against a target prorated to the days elapsed?
denominator_stated.fix: 分母を書く。経過日按分（月次目標×経過日÷日数）か月次目標かを明示

mixed_basis.label: 基準の混在
mixed_basis.instructions: Does the document mix figures on different bases — monthly versus cumulative, before versus after deductions, confirmed versus projected — without labeling which is which?
mixed_basis.fix: 月次と累計、控除前と控除後、確定と見込みを分けてラベルする

label_period_mismatch.label: ラベルと期間のずれの疑い
label_period_mismatch.instructions: Is there any figure whose label may not match what it measures — for example a figure labelled as one month's sales that, from its magnitude or surrounding text, looks like a cumulative or annual total?
label_period_mismatch.fix: 発言記録まで降りて、その数字が単月か累計かを確定する（最頻の型）

internal_contradiction.label: 文書内の矛盾
internal_contradiction.instructions: Do any two figures or statements within the document contradict each other?
internal_contradiction.fix: どちらが正しいか一次資料で確定し、片方に揃える

source_cited.label: 出典（会議名・日付・シート）
source_cited.instructions: Are the figures attributed to a source such as a meeting name with date, or a spreadsheet and tab name with retrieval date?
source_cited.fix: 会議名と日付、またはシート名・タブ名・取得日を添える

hedging.label: 「〜と思われる」で逃げていない
hedging.instructions: Does the document use hedging expressions equivalent to 'it seems' or 'it is thought that' on points that could have been verified?
hedging.fix: 確認したなら言い切る。確認していないなら「未確認」と明示

regulated_domain.label: 規制（薬機・医療広告・景表法・失業保険・補助金・株式）
regulated_domain.instructions: Does the document touch a regulated domain: pharmaceutical or health-efficacy claims, medical advertising, consumer-labelling rules, unemployment-insurance procedures, government subsidies, or securities and equity?
regulated_domain.fix: 該当する規制の線を確認し、有資格者に当てる箇所を明示する

external_facing.label: 対外に出る文書（参考）
external_facing.instructions: Is this document intended to be sent to or read by someone outside the company (a partner, customer, or prospect)?
